subject: [hw] X01 start: n2vc_hw op log, log2script, diff_logs (hwlog/**)
body: Reading PLAN, TASK, include/n2vc_hw.h and T02 recorder+script grammar. I own gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/** only. Plan: a thread-safe decorator that forwards the frozen struct n2vc_hw exactly, logs one line per op in T02 record syntax with ts_us prefix and an explicit result suffix, CRC-32 (never data) for dma_rw, 16 MB default cap with a final truncation line; log2script.py builds a T02 script and a register summary; diff_logs.py aligns the write sequence and normalizes DMA pool-base differences. Host test wraps T02 fake, compares a literal expected log with a deterministic test clock, round-trips through log2script, checks diff output, ASan/UBSan + -O2 + TSan. No phone access, no daemon edits. Interface question to hw-t02/hw-lead follows in the next post.
